sub_answers.sub_question: Which formal investigations, criminal charges, indictments, or prosecutions have been initiated against the politician (include agency names, case numbers, dates, specific allegations or statutes cited) and what is the disposition of each (dropped, acquitted, convicted, plea, ongoing) with sources?
sub_answers.text:
Four criminal indictments were filed against Donald Trump in 2023, two state indictments (New York and Georgia) and two federal indictments (Florida and the District of Columbia) [d73425097s0p0].
Trump pleaded not guilty to all charges in those indictments [d73425097s0p0].
Trump was convicted in the New York state case and the Georgia state case was initially charged in August 2023 with 8 remaining counts related to alleged attempts to overturn Georgia's 2020 result after five of 13 original counts were dismissed, and that Georgia case was ultimately dropped on November 26, 2025 [d73425097s0p0][d73425097s4p0][d74593923s0p0].
Both federal cases were dismissed following events around his 2024 election and related Justice Department actions and resignations, and neither the indictments nor convictions would have disqualified his 2024 presidential candidacy [d73425097s0p0].

sub_answers.text: In the 2014 Telangana Legislative Assembly election the party won 5 seats [d65350513s1p0]. In the 2018 Telangana Legislative Assembly election the party won 1 seat and its vote share was 7.10% [d65350513s1p0]. In the 2019 Lok Sabha election in Telangana the party won 4 out of 17 seats and obtained 19.45% of the total votes in the state [d65350513s1p0]. In the 2023 Telangana Legislative Assembly election the party won 8 seats with a vote share of 13.90% [d65350513s1p0]. In the 2014 Lok Sabha election the party won the Secunderabad constituency [d65350513s1p0]. In the 2024 Indian general election in Telangana the party increased its tally to 8 Lok Sabha seats and secured a vote share of 35.08% [d65350513s1p0]. The change in assembly seats was from 5 seats in 2014 to 1 seat in 2018 and then to 8 seats in 2023 [d65350513s1p0]. The change in Lok Sabha seats was from winning Secunderabad in 2014 to 4 seats in 2019 and to 8 seats in 2024 [d65350513s1p0]. The year-to-year vote-share swings include +12.35 percentage points from 2018 (7.10%) to 2019 (19.45%), -5.55 percentage points from 2019 (19.45%) to 2023 (13.90%), and +21.18 percentage points from 2023 (13.90%) to 2024 (35.08%) [d65350513s1p0].
